claimBoundary: This additive campaign expands neutral, source-bound A/B review coverage without changing or relabeling the retained v0.16.11 evidence. Model identity and deterministic checks do not label a winner.

groups.title: Python Program Architecture Studio
groups.courseBrief: Python Program Architecture Studio, a six-session intermediate programming course in which students trace iteration, transform text, persist data, compare recursive and iterative solutions, and design small class-based programs.

groups.title: Earth Materials and History Lab
groups.courseBrief: Earth Materials and History Lab, a six-session undergraduate geology course in which students identify minerals, distinguish weathering from erosion, interpret sedimentary and metamorphic evidence, connect rock-cycle transformations, and order events in geologic time.

groups.title: Tonal Analysis Integration Studio
groups.courseBrief: Tonal Analysis Integration Studio, a six-session college music-theory course in which students connect notation, interval and scale relationships, chord construction, harmonic progression, and formal evidence in short analytical decisions.

groups.title: UX Evidence-to-Prototype Capstone
groups.courseBrief: UX Evidence-to-Prototype Capstone, a six-session project course in which students plan research, synthesize personas and journeys, model task flows, build testable prototypes, and combine accessibility conformance with observed usability evidence.
